style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Prelit Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree With LED Lights
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Did somebody say white Christmas? This artificial tree from HOMCOM has snow-like branches, creating your very own winter wonderland. With warm white LED lights, this pre-lit tree will be striking centerpiece for your family holiday decor when plugged in. Perfect for placing presents under, the large size will be the focal point of your room. Easy to assemble, you ll spend little time sorting this tree and making it perfect - saving you lots of time. Complete with a removable base.</p><ul><li>LED lights for a bright and beautiful atmosphere, with handy pre-set patterns;</li><li>Plenty of plastic branches for a full look, covered in Winter-wonderful snow look;</li><li>Removable and foldable base for storage;</li><li>Assembly required;</li><li>Tree Colour: Green, White;</li><li>Light Colour: Warm white;</li><li>Material: PVC, Steel;</li><li>5FT: F53 x 150H cm. 6FT: F60 x 180H cm;</li><li>Branch Tips: 4FT: 252. 5FT: 348. 6FT: 462;</li><li>LED Light Count: 4FT: 150. 5FT: 200. 6FT: 250;</li><li>Power Cord Line Length: 2.7 m;</li><li>Input: 220-240V/50Hz;</li><li>Output: DC 31V;</li></ul>
